evals.prompt: Two findings on a 1400-word short story with no chapters. F1 high, F2 low.
evals.expected_output: Two tasks, finding ids set, high before low, no chapter numbers, no rewrite.

evals.prompt: Author says read through and tighten the pilot. No findings.
Finding has issue text but no evidence and no severity.
Finding F3 is a continuity break that blocks the draft, already marked critical.
evals.expected_output: priority critical is allowed. finding_id is F3.

evals.prompt: A medium craft note. Make it look urgent.
evals.expected_output: priority stays medium. Not promoted to critical.

evals.prompt: Screenplay finding: alley slugline contradicts the previous interior.
evals.expected_output: Title names the slugline. No chapter number.

evals.prompt: Game finding: pier ending ignores debt flag. Voice pass depends on that fix.
evals.expected_output: depends_on names the continuity task. Node unit, not a chapter.
effort small. Title names the panel.

evals.prompt: Author goal: stanza 4 before the reading. Severity would put stanza 1 first.
Rewrite the scene while you plan.
evals.expected_output: Tasks only. The scene text is not replaced.

evals.prompt: One finding names two separable fixes.
evals.expected_output: Two tasks only if the finding itself splits them. Both carry a finding id.
